messages.subject: [rhipe] Bug fix in 0.59
parts:
Hello,
There is a new version of Rhipe , the version is still v0.59.

This fixes a bug in rhlapply, which ran but failed to read in the data(notified by eddyhu)

Changes:
Added a class to the rhoptions()$version, which when called looks like

> rhoptions()$version
RHIPE: major is 0.59 , minor is 1
Date:Thu Apr 22 12:37:06 EDT 2010
Notes: Fixed rhlapply which failed to read in data properly


This will be of use to all who use since I make changes but keep major the same.
There will never be more than one update to the package per day (keeps us all sane)


Regards
Saptarshi
